verdict.rationale: The Codex CLI source is publicly hosted at github.com/openai/codex, including the Rust source tree (codex-rs). A community comment contrasts the closed Codex App with the CLI, implying the CLI is open source and diagnosable. However, no evidence names the license, and the desktop App and cloud agent are indicated to be closed. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented open-source license, open source for the Codex App and cloud components, and first-party statements of openness.
